channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jeremiah Fears | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jeremiah Fears from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Saddiq Bey on Micah Peavy, Derik Queen, Jeremiah Fears
item.description:
Jim Eichenhofer:Saddiq Bey on #Pelicans 2025 draft-night additions Jeremiah Fears, Derik Queen and Micah Peavy:

“They’re a great rookie class. All of them have tremendous confidence, are very coachable, played a lot of high-level basketball (in college). The lights, they’re ready for them.”

Saddiq Bey on Micah Peavy, Derik Queen, Jeremiah Fears, Nov 7, 2025. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Joe Dumars on Jeremiah Fears
item.description:
JimEichenhofer: Joe Dumars on 7th pick Jeremiah Fears' work ethic:

“We had to stop him coming in to the gym for awhile, because his legs were getting so sore.(I told him) I know you're 18, but you've got to rest. He's working out super hard in the morning, then he's coming back at night.”

Joe Dumars on Jeremiah Fears, Sep 22, 2025. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Joe Dumars on Jeremiah Fears
item.description:
Dumars on Jeremiah Fears' off-the-dribble and attacking offensive game:

“I like his skill set, his ability to get anywhere on the court at any time... You have to have guys who can compromise the other team's defense.”

Joe Dumars on Jeremiah Fears, Jun 25, 2025. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.
